provenance: FIXTURE, not user evidence. The corpus starts from the library documents scripts/seed_demo.py publishes (titles ending in '(sample)'), kept word for word, and adds six short fixture documents (titles ending in '(fixture)') so the set has enough passages to rank. Every case and every expected hit was written by hand from these documents, not from historic requirements or from knowledge admins' searches. A case's text is phrased as a requirement (title and description) or as a rule sentence. An expected hit names the document and a passage the retrieved chunk must contain, or the block label the chunk must carry. Cases marked 'semantic' share few or no words with their passage: they are expected to miss with the fake hash embedding and are there to be measured against real embeddings.

documents.title: Bundle ordering procedure (sample)
documents.text:
# Ordering a business fibre bundle (sample)
Confirm XGPON coverage at the customer's address before quoting.
Check the site has a free optical port; book a survey if it does not.
Quote the bundle only after coverage and the port are confirmed.
Record the coverage reference on the order.

documents.text: ADSL orders go through the legacy portal.

documents.text: Discounts show on the invoice line.

documents.title: Static IP allocation (fixture)
documents.text:
# Static IP addressing (fixture)
A business fibre bundle may include one static public IPv4 address.
Additional static addresses need a justification recorded on the order.
Static addresses are released when the bundle is ceased.

documents.title: Managed firewall service (fixture)
documents.text:
# Managed firewall (fixture)
The managed firewall is provisioned on the customer's CPE after the line is activated.
Firewall rule changes are requested through the self-service portal.
A rule change is applied within one working day.

documents.title: Service level targets (fixture)
documents.text:
# Service levels (fixture)
Installation is completed within five working days of the coverage confirmation.
Severity 2 faults are acknowledged within one hour and resolved within eight hours.
Service credits are applied to the next invoice when a target is missed.

documents.title: Customer identity verification (fixture)
documents.text:
# Identity checks (fixture)
A trade licence is verified before a business account is opened.
The signatory's Emirates ID is checked against the trade licence.
Expired trade licences block new orders until renewed.

documents.title: Site survey and installation (fixture)
documents.text:
# Site survey (fixture)
A site survey is booked when no free optical port is recorded at the address.
The technician confirms the optical port and the router location during the survey.
Installation is scheduled only after the survey is closed.

documents.title: Mobile backup access (fixture)
documents.text:
# Mobile backup (fixture)
A 4G backup SIM keeps the site online when the fibre line fails.
Backup traffic is capped at the bundle's backup allowance.
The SIM is activated with the fibre line and billed on the same invoice.
